name: Huntarr-Readarr
description:
DEPRECATED: Use Huntarr instead. 
        [br]
        Huntarr (Readarr Edition) continually searches your Readarr library for missing books or books that need quality upgrades. It automatically triggers searches for both missing books and books below your quality cutoff. It's designed to run continuously while being gentle on your indexers, helping you gradually complete your book collection with the best available quality.
requires: Requires a separate Readarr v1 instance.

variables.name: Readarr - API Key
variables.description: API key for your Readarr instance

variables.name: Readarr - Skip Future Releases
variables.description: Skip processing books with release dates in the future

variables.name: Huntarr - Missing Books Per Cycle
variables.description: Maximum missing books to process per cycle. Set to 0 to disable.

variables.name: Huntarr - Upgrade Books Per Cycle
variables.description: Maximum upgrade books to process per cycle. Set to 0 to disable.

variables.name: Huntarr - Use Random Selection
variables.description: Use random selection for processing if enabled, or sequential if disabled.

variables.name: Huntarr - Minimum Queue Size
variables.description: Minimum number of items in the download queue before starting a hunt. Set to -1 to disable.

variables.name: Huntarr - Refresh Author Metadata
variables.description: Refresh author metadata before processing book

variables.name: Readarr - API Timeout
variables.description: Timeout for API requests in seconds.

variables.name: Huntarr - Sleep Duration
variables.description: Duration, in seconds, to wait between cycles.

variables.name: Huntarr - Reset Interval
variables.description: Interval, in hours, after which to reset the processed state files. Set to 0 to disable.

variables.name: Debug Mode
variables.description: Enable debug mode for detailed logging.

variables.name: Command Status - Wait Time
variables.description: Delay in seconds between checking for command status

variables.name: Command Status - Max Attempts
variables.description: Maximum number of attempts to check for command status
